### Animals
API | Description | Auth | HTTPS | CORS
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| [AdoptAPet](https://www.adoptapet.com/public/apis/pet_list.html) | Resource to help get pets adopted | `apiKey` | Yes | Yes |
| [Cat Facts](https://catfact.ninja/) | Random cat facts | No | Yes | Yes |
| [Cats](https://docs.thecatapi.com/) | Pictures of cats from Tumblr | `apiKey` | Yes | No |
| [OpenWeatherMap](https://openweathermap.org/api) | Weather | `apiKey` | Yes | Yes |
| [AniList](https://github.com/AniList/ApiV2-GraphQL-Docs) | Anime tracking | `OAuth` | Yes | Unknown |
